  body.printing-scorecard .scorecard-table td,
  body.printing-scorecard .leader-table th,
  body.printing-scorecard .leader-table td,
  body.printing-scorecard .payout-game-table th,
  body.printing-scorecard .payout-game-table td,

  body.printing-scorecard .settlement-table td

Preserved paint for body.printing-scorecard; body.printing-scorecard .scorecard-table th,
  body.printing-scorecard .scorecard-table td,
  body.printing-scorecard .leader-table th,
  body.printing-scorecard .leader-table td,
  body.printing-scorecard .payout-game-table th,
  body.printing-scorecard .payout-game-table td,
  body.printing-scorecard .settlement-table th,
  body.printing-scorecard .settlement-table td; .score-number
